text.arabic_uthmani: وَهُدُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلطَّيِّبِ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ وَهُدُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ

words.gloss_range: opening connector linking the ayah to the prior reward scene; locally it can coordinate continuation or resume explanatory movement
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) makes the ayah begin as connected discourse, not as an isolated report. It keeps the paradise scene of 22:23 open while the first passive guidance clause explains or adds the inner orientation behind that reward. Its short bound form also launches directly into the guidance verb, so the boundary relation and the predicate are heard as one connected movement.

topics.headline: opening connector bridges reward and guidance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah carries forward the prior reward scene while pivoting into the guidance that explains it.
topics.reason: The QAC and attachment evidence identify the opening particle as a coordinating connector before the passive verbal clause.

topics.headline: bound particle opens into passive verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the small connector is not decorative; it audibly carries the listener into the first guidance predicate.
topics.reason: The particle is positioned at the ayah edge and bound in recitation flow to the following passive clause.

words.gloss_range: passive completed guidance received by the same group, directed through a goal phrase toward the good within speech
words.root_gloss_range: guiding, leading, showing direction, conduct, gift-sending, and sacrificial driving; locally the passive with a goal complement selects received direction while gift and driving imagery remain pressure
words.prose: {{ar:هُدُوا}} ({{tr:hudū}}) presents guidance as a completed action received by the group already in view from 22:23. The passive form suppresses the guide and foregrounds the recipients plus the destination, while the goal phrase makes guidance directional rather than a possessed object. Root-family pressure lets the action feel conducted and bestowed, and the visible ungeminated form blocks an unrelated h-d-d collapse or threat reading; the local frame still selects guidance toward speech-quality. The first occurrence also sets up the exact reprise at word 8, with the long ū cadence helping both guidance beats sound paired, so the ayah will make one received guidance movement cover speech first and path next. The same root also belongs to a surah-local guidance thread, including path guidance at 22:54 and sacrifice guidance at 22:37.

topics.headline: passive perfect with omitted guide
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the guided group is foregrounded while the guide remains unspoken, making guidance something received rather than self-produced.
topics.reason: The aligned form is passive perfect 3mp with no explicit agent, and the boundary evidence keeps the same recipients from the previous ayah.

topics.headline: guidance completed through a goal phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices guidance as directed movement toward a target, not as simple possession of good speech.
topics.reason: The verb is completed by a prepositional complement, and the first goal is the good specified within speech.

topics.headline: conducted and bestowed guidance, not h-d-d
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the guidance as conducted and received like a bestowed direction, while the visible ungeminated form blocks an unrelated collapse or threat reading.
topics.reason: The local root alignment is {{ar:ه د ي}} ({{tr:h-d-y}}); gift and sacrificial-driving branches add image-pressure but do not replace the selected guidance sense.

topics.headline: first guidance prepares exact reprise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first verb is a template for the second, making the changed complements the ayah's main contrast.
topics.reason: The same passive perfect form recurs at word 8, coordinated with the first occurrence.

topics.headline: guidance field, cadence, and boundary continuity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this rare passive form joins local speech guidance to a wider path-guidance field and to the same recipients from the prior reward scene.
topics.reason: The contextual profile marks the passive perfect group as low-occurrence, while the ayah repeats it in a paired guidance structure.

words.gloss_range: directional preposition marking the first guidance goal and preserving movement toward an endpoint
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَى}} ({{tr:ilā}}) turns the first guidance into a goal-directed relation. It makes the following good quality the destination slot of the passive verb, while still preserving the feel of movement or orientation. Because the same preposition returns in the second beat, both guidance clauses share one syntactic frame even though their complements differ.

topics.headline: first goal phrase for guidance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the guidance is oriented toward a goal, not merely attached to a quality word.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the following genitive complement and attaches to the first passive guidance verb.

topics.headline: first ilā anticipates second ilā
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the destination slot before its content and then hears the same slot repeated in the second clause.
topics.reason: Both guidance clauses use the same verb-preposition pattern, giving the complements formal comparability.

words.gloss_range: the recognizable good, pure, wholesome, and morally fit quality selected as the first guidance goal and specified within speech
words.root_gloss_range: pleasantness, purity, fragrance, wholesomeness, lawful/moral goodness, and making good; locally the substantivized adjective selects an enduring speech-quality rather than an action of purifying
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلطَّيِّبِ}} ({{tr:al-ṭayyibi}}) is the first destination of guidance and is then narrowed to the speech domain. As a definite substantivized adjective, it names the recognizable good or pure quality without reducing it to one quoted utterance. The root's pleasantness and fragrance field makes the speech-quality feel clean, wholesome, and perceptible, while the local form keeps the focus on an enduring quality rather than an act of making something good. Structurally, this quality object balances the later path object: guidance reaches what is said before it reaches the route that closes the ayah, and the good-word resonance includes the good word likened to a good tree (14:24). The doubled emphatic sound in the quality word gives the selected good audible compression before the phrase narrows into speech.

topics.headline: good quality as guided destination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the good is both the guidance goal and a quality specified within speech.
topics.reason: The word is governed by the first goal preposition and then specified by the following speech-domain phrase.

topics.headline: definite adjective becomes a unified noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the wording gathers goodness as a recognizable quality, not as multiple listed good sayings or a verbal event.
topics.reason: The local form is a definite genitive qualitative adjective functioning substantively.

topics.headline: sensory purity transferred to speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that speech goodness is more than correctness; it carries purity, wholesomeness, and pleasantness as live evaluative pressure.
topics.reason: The root family supports sensory and moral goodness, while the local phrase restricts the application to speech-quality.

topics.headline: quality object balances later path object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's architecture: guidance first purifies utterance and then directs the whole path, with good-word resonance including 14:24.
topics.reason: The local phrase explicitly pairs the quality word with speech and then contrasts it with the second guidance complement; the source row gives the concrete 14:24 echo.

topics.headline: compressed sound at the quality word
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a small audible marking at the quality word before the phrase narrows into the speech domain.
topics.reason: The sound observation is tied to the local doubled consonant and does not require a new lexical sense.

words.gloss_range: specifying preposition that can mark partitive, explicative, or source relation within the speech phrase
words.prose: {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) narrows the open good quality by making speech the domain from which, or in which, that good is identified. Its partitive and explicative possibilities matter: the phrase can sort good speech from the broader field of utterance or clarify that the relevant good consists in speech. The local attachment favors specification of the quality word, while the row's broader domain reading survives as the reader-facing sense that speech is being classified, not praised wholesale. The compact phrase also marks the boundary shift from clothing and covering in 22:23 to purified speech and verbal transparency in 22:24.

topics.headline: min sorts or explains the speech domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that speech is internally classified: the good is drawn from, or identified within, the speech domain.
topics.reason: The QAC row allows partitive or explicative force, while attachment evidence governs the following speech noun as the specifying complement.

topics.headline: postposed phrase narrows the quality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the sequence opening the good as a goal and then narrowing its relevant domain to speech.
topics.reason: The local attachment makes the following noun specify the quality word; treating it as a broader domain of guidance remains possible only as a qualified reading.

topics.headline: compact phrase and boundary shift into speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the phrase binding tightly into the speech domain as the discourse moves from outer reward imagery to refined verbal orientation.
topics.reason: The preposition and following noun form a compact governed phrase, and the boundary row supplies the prior-scene contrast.

words.gloss_range: the definite speech domain, including the act and product of articulated expression, from which the good is specified
words.root_gloss_range: saying, uttering, declaring, speech, statement, opinion, and discourse; locally the gerund selects articulated expression as a guided field rather than attribution or speculative idiom
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْقَوْلِ}} ({{tr:al-qawli}}) is not the immediate guidance destination; it is the governed speech domain that specifies the good. Because the word is a definite verbal noun, it keeps both saying-as-act and utterance-as-product in view. That makes verbal expression itself a guided field, not merely a list of acceptable words. The singular definite gerund frames the Quran's major speech root as one unified domain here, rather than manipulated attributed speech or scattered plural sayings. The first beat then lands on speech while the ayah's final word lands on praiseworthiness, so human utterance is placed under the evaluative horizon of the closing praise-root and within the surah's later speech network at 22:30, 22:40, and 22:68.

topics.headline: speech as specifying domain, not direct destination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that speech specifies the good being sought, while the immediate guidance goal remains the good quality.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive under the specifying preposition, whereas the prior quality word fills the first guidance goal.

topics.headline: definite gerund preserves saying as act and product
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices guidance reaching the process and field of expression, not only a finished speech product.
topics.reason: The local form is a definite gerund, and the semantic rows support broad articulated expression without shifting into unrelated idioms.

topics.headline: singular speech domain over manipulated or plural sayings
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the Quran's major speech root framed here as a unified guided domain, not as attributed speech or scattered quotations.
topics.reason: The local gerund supports speech as expression, while Form II attribution and other idioms are not selected by the local construction.

topics.headline: speech field answers praise closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that guided speech is not isolated; it moves toward the ayah's praise-defined closure and remains part of the surah's speech network.
topics.reason: The local phrase links speech with guidance, and the ayah later closes on the praise-root epithet.

topics.headline: first beat lands on speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the first beat settling on the speech-domain noun before the second guidance clause restarts.
topics.reason: The sound row is locally tied to the phrase-final speech noun and its transition into the next clause.

words.gloss_range: medial coordinator restarting the same passive guidance frame and pivoting from speech-quality to path-guidance
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) restarts the same guidance frame instead of merely appending another noun. That makes the second half a coordinated parallel clause with its own destination, so speech guidance and path guidance stand side by side. The repeated bound opening also gives the listener a formal reset: the same passive action resumes, but the semantic domain shifts from utterance quality to route and destination.

topics.headline: second connector coordinates a full guidance clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second half is a full parallel guidance beat, not a subordinate tail of the speech phrase.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the second passive clause as coordinated with the first.

topics.headline: particle pivots from speech to path
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the medial connector as the hinge where the repeated frame shifts domains.
topics.reason: The particle is bound to the repeated passive verb and occurs exactly at the transition from first to second guidance destination.

topics.headline: same opening cadence returns
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the second beat as a reset because it repeats the same short connector plus guidance cadence.
topics.reason: The sound row is tied to the exact repeated sequence at the start of each guidance beat.

words.gloss_range: second passive completed guidance received by the same group, now directed toward the praise-defined path
words.root_gloss_range: guiding, leading, showing direction, conduct, gift-sending, and sacrificial driving; locally the repeated passive selects received orientation onto a path while concrete driving imagery strengthens the movement
words.prose: The second {{ar:هُدُوا}} ({{tr:hudū}}) repeats the first verb exactly, including passive perfect form and omitted guide, but the complement changes. That sameness makes the path phrase carry the expansion: guidance reaches not only speech but a life-route defined by praiseworthiness. The root's conducted-motion pressure is stronger here because the complement is a path, while the local grammar still presents the route as received direction rather than self-discovered navigation. The local phrase also enters the guidance-to-path configuration that returns in the same surah at 22:54. The boundary rows make the verse retrospective: after the reward scene of 22:23, this repeated verb names the completed guidance that explains how the same group arrived there.

topics.headline: agent omitted again with same recipients
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the second path movement as received guidance by the same group, not independent self-navigation.
topics.reason: The second verb repeats passive perfect 3mp with an unexpressed agent.

topics.headline: same verb now governs the path
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the semantic expansion from guided speech to guided route because the verb stays the same and the complement changes.
topics.reason: The second verb takes the path phrase as its governed goal complement.

topics.headline: driving image intensifies movement onto the route
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that guidance toward the path feels like conducted movement, while the local passive frame keeps guidance as the selected sense.
topics.reason: Root-family driving imagery fits the path complement as pressure, but the local construction remains passive guidance toward a route.

topics.headline: formulaic guidance-to-path pairing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the local phrase entering a familiar guidance-path configuration, including the same-surah path guidance at 22:54.
topics.reason: The local syntax directly realizes the guidance-plus-path relation, and the source rows give same-surah and praise-root connections.

topics.headline: exact verbal reprise explains the reward scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the repeated verb as the ayah's backbone, turning the verse into a retrospective explanation of the prior paradise scene.
topics.reason: The same form recurs eight words apart with a different complement, while boundary rows connect the reward scene to the completed guidance report.

words.gloss_range: second directional preposition marking the path as the goal of received guidance
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ilā}}) reprises the first goal-marker but now points toward a path. The repeated preposition locks both halves into the same syntax, so the contrast between speech-quality and route becomes visible against a stable grammatical template. Its second use makes the path an endpoint of received guidance, not a decorative image after the verb.

topics.headline: second ilā governs the path goal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the route as the governed endpoint of guidance, not as an unattached path image.
topics.reason: The preposition attaches to the second passive guidance verb and governs the following path noun.

topics.headline: two ilā phrases create comparable beats
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices both guidance targets becoming formally comparable because the same preposition occupies the same slot in each clause.
topics.reason: The two prepositions mirror each other after the two passive guidance verbs.

words.gloss_range: a clear path or route used abstractly as the second guidance goal, bound in construct to the Praiseworthy
words.root_gloss_range: path, road, clear course, and contested or native swallowing/passage associations; locally the path sense governs, while etymological and passage pressure remains narrowed image-pressure
words.prose: {{ar:صِرَٰطِ}} ({{tr:ṣirāṭi}}) turns the second guidance goal into a route, not merely an idea. It is genitive under the second goal preposition and, as a construct head, remains incomplete until the final praise-root epithet defines it. The local sense is an abstract but road-shaped path: clear, traversable, and established as the route of guidance. Swallowing or passage etymology is narrowed to background pressure, making the path feel like a route one enters and is carried through rather than replacing the path sense. The word also carries canonical ṣād/sīn/ishmām sound variation while preserving the same route referent, and it contrasts with the straight-path frame of 1:6 while 22:54 later reuses the path image with a different qualifier. Its emphatic consonantal texture helps make the penultimate route word a weight-bearing hinge before the final praise-root closure.

topics.headline: path governed by guidance and bound to final epithet
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the path as both the governed guidance endpoint and a construct head waiting for the final epithet to define it.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive under the second goal preposition and forms an iḍāfa with the following divine epithet.

topics.headline: possessive, descriptive, or telic path relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the construct can define the path by belonging, quality, or destination without expanding beyond the compact phrase.
topics.reason: The iḍāfa grammar licenses several genitive relations while keeping the phrase locally bound.

topics.headline: clear road image for abstract guidance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices guidance becoming movement onto a clear route, while the route remains moral and evaluative rather than a physical road.
topics.reason: The path noun has concrete road imagery, but distribution and the praise-root construct support abstract guidance here.

topics.headline: swallowing etymology and canonical sound variants
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the path word as etymologically and phonetically marked, while all canonical variants preserve the same route referent.
topics.reason: The swallowing or loanword pressure and recitational variants add apparatus and texture, but local grammar selects the path noun.

topics.headline: guidance-path formula with praise qualifier
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices this path as part of the guidance-path field, but locally defined by praiseworthiness rather than straightness, with contrasts at 1:6 and 22:54.
topics.reason: The local phrase pairs guidance with path and binds the path to the praise-root epithet; the source rows give concrete 1:6 and 22:54 contrasts.

topics.headline: penultimate path begins final closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the path word as the hinge where sound variation, route imagery, and final semantic closure begin.
topics.reason: The construct head is penultimate and phonologically marked, so its pressure is local rather than decorative.

words.gloss_range: the definite praise-root epithet completing the path construct as the Praiseworthy, praiseworthy quality, or praise-defined destination
words.root_gloss_range: praising, being praised, commending, gratitude, satisfaction, and intrinsic praiseworthiness; locally the faʿīl epithet supplies an abiding divine praise-root seal
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْحَمِيدِ}} ({{tr:al-ḥamīdi}}) completes the construct and gives the path its final anchor. Its definiteness makes the anchor identifiable, while the genitive relation can be heard possessively, descriptively, or teleologically: the path belongs to the Praiseworthy, is praise-defined, or leads toward the Praised One. The chosen faʿīl epithet gives the close abiding praiseworthiness rather than a mere act of praise or a simple passive participle, with active and passive force both available in the pattern. The rare path-praise pairing makes the route not merely straight or safe but keyed to praiseworthiness. As the final word, it seals the two guidance beats: speech is guided toward goodness, and the route is guided toward the praise-root attribute that later appears explicitly in 22:64. Its ḥāʾ-mīm-dāl articulation moves from deep throat resonance through nasal sound to dental stop, giving the rarer adjective/name pattern audible settling at the ayah seal.

topics.headline: final epithet completes the path construct
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the path remains unresolved until the definite praise-root epithet anchors it.
topics.reason: The word is the definite genitive muḍāf ilayhi completing the path iḍāfa.

topics.headline: possessive, descriptive, and telic readings
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the compact phrase defining the route by belonging, praiseworthy quality, or destination toward the Praiseworthy.
topics.reason: The genitive grammar licenses these relational readings without making them separate local words.

topics.headline: abiding faʿīl praiseworthiness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the closing attribute as intrinsic and abiding praiseworthiness, not merely the record that praise has happened.
topics.reason: The local form is the faʿīl epithet/name, so verbal-noun praise and passive participle contrasts remain form pressure rather than replacement.

topics.headline: praise-root closure evaluates the whole arc
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah moving from good speech to a praise-root path, so both halves are held under positive moral evaluation.
topics.reason: The final word is a praise-root divine epithet that resolves the second guidance destination and frames the two-beat structure.

topics.headline: rare path-praise pairing and same-surah return
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the closing path-praise configuration as marked, with the same epithet later made explicit as a divine attribute at 22:64.
topics.reason: The contextual evidence is strongly theocentric, and the source rows give the concrete same-surah 22:64 comparison.

topics.headline: from speech quality to praise-root identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's full arc from purified utterance to praiseworthy destination, not two unrelated rewards.
topics.reason: The first beat centers a quality of speech and the second closes on a divine praise-root epithet.

topics.headline: audible and distributional weight at the seal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final epithet carrying audible settling and rare-form closure weight at the end of the connected guidance frame.
topics.reason: The sound and distribution rows are tied to the final word's placement as the ayah seal.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled passive hudu, each followed by ila, coordinates al-tayyib min al-qawl with sirat al-Hamid as two destinations.
baseline_models.mechanism: Gentle direction first selects wholesome utterance and then places its recipients on a straight course belonging to or terminating in the Praiseworthy.

activation_trace.role: Gentle indication toward road and truth supplies the repeated directional action governing both complements.
Goodness, purity, and lawfulness make the selected speech morally and affectively sound.
Articulated utterance gives the first destination an audible and relational medium.
The straight road turns the second destination into sustained movement rather than a single saying.
The one rich in praised qualities identifies the route by its praiseworthy owner or goal.

changed_reading.before: The verse simply reports pleasant words and a good road among rewards.
changed_reading.after: The verse depicts two coordinated formations of agency: purified speaking and durable travel on the Praiseworthy's course.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Min al-qawl can reach beyond voiced language, while the movement from qawl to sirat can mark a passage from inward assent to lived direction.
baseline_models.mechanism: A willing, uncoerced soul receives wholesome inward speech or belief; the repeated guidance then converts that assent into a settled manner of proceeding toward a praiseworthy end.

activation_trace.role: Direction, intent, and manner let guidance govern an orientation or conduct as well as a road.
The soul becoming pleased without coercion supplies voluntary inward reception.
Speech conceived within before vocalization makes the first guidance interior as well as audible.
Speech as belief gives the wholesome saying a durable cognitive commitment.
The straight road embodies inward assent as a continuing course.
A praiseworthy utmost end gives the inward-to-outward movement its telos.

changed_reading.before: Good speech is only something heard or spoken in the final scene.
changed_reading.after: Guidance can begin as freely accepted inward conviction and become an embodied course toward a praiseworthy end.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier h-d-y plus ila construction leads under corrupt patronage to punishment. Its reuse in the focus makes guidance a routing operation whose moral value is supplied by guide and destination; the doubled focus routing reverses the destructive destination into wholesome speech and the Praiseworthy's course.

activation_trace.role: Direction and intent let the same h-d-y plus ila syntax function as routing even when its endpoint is punishment.
Deviation from guidance and purpose marks the corrupt orientation that feeds the punitive route.
Repeated direction now splits the corrected routing across a verbal destination and a traversed destination.
Wholesome purity supplies the positive valence absent from guidance considered by itself.
The richly praiseworthy owner or goal supplies the second route's positive valence.

structural_cues: 22:4 couples a misleading patron's causing error with guiding a follower to blazing punishment, while 22:24 repeats passive guidance and supplies two contrary destinations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated h-d-y plus ila frame and opposite endpoints; I infer that routing is the shared function and destination supplies its valence. A live alternative is that 22:4 is punitive irony rather than evidence for a directionally neutral core.

changed_reading.before: Guidance is intrinsically beneficent, so the destinations merely restate what guidance already guarantees.
changed_reading.after: Guidance is morally contested routing, and 22:24 stages a decisive rerouting away from destructive patronage into wholesome speech and the Praiseworthy's way.

context_deltas.mechanism: Entry, adornment, and clothing are complete before the doubled guidance is named. The focus therefore adds a post-entry formation of voice and bearing: paradise is inhabited through learned wholesome relation and calm movement, not exhausted by location and possessions.

activation_trace.role: Passage into an interior establishes that admission precedes the focus guidance.
Adornment supplies an already transformed outward presentation before speech and path are taught.
Covering with clothing completes the material outfitting that the focus then exceeds.
Calmness and good bearing turn the doubled guidance into cultivated comportment after entry.
Voiced speech supplies the relational practice added to material adornment.
A straight road supplies ongoing bearing within the entered place.

structural_cues: 22:23 orders entry, flowing gardens, jewelry, and silk immediately before 22:24's two passive guidances.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies narrative order; I infer a progression from external placement and adornment to verbal and dispositional cultivation. A live alternative is that the clauses list simultaneous gifts without a temporal or pedagogical sequence.

changed_reading.before: Admission and adornment complete the reward, with 22:24 adding decorative praise.
changed_reading.after: Even after admission, recipients are cultivated into a fitting voice and gait; paradisal reward includes learned social and ethical inhabitation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pilgrimage block joins a destination-oriented journey through distant passes, voiced remembrance, circling movement, rejection of counterfeit speech, and thanksgiving for guidance. The focus pair condenses this ritual technology: speech is purified while bodies are directed along a praising itinerary.

activation_trace.role: Intentional travel toward what is revered supplies the itinerary's orienting purpose.
A broad pass opened between mountains gives the path concrete long-distance terrain.
Remembrance running on the tongue makes correct utterance an action within the route.
Circling around a center converts orientation into repeated bodily movement.
Saying what was not so supplies the counterfeit verbal pole that wholesome speech excludes.
Falsehood and fabrication specify the distortion from which ritual speech must turn aside.
Guidance toward truth becomes the stated ground for magnifying God at the itinerary's sacrificial culmination.
The focus utterance gathers voiced remembrance and the exclusion of false saying into one positive destination.
The focus road gathers distant approach and repeated circling into a coherent praising course.

structural_cues: 22:27-30 orders arrival through deep passes, remembrance of God's name, completion of rites, circumambulation, and avoidance of false speech.
22:37 closes the sacrifice sequence by making prior guidance the reason for magnifying God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered verbal and bodily rites; I infer that the focus's speech-path pair is a compressed ritual mechanism rather than two unrelated rewards. A live alternative is that the pilgrimage sequence only analogically echoes an exclusively eschatological focus scene.

changed_reading.before: The good saying and praised path are abstract or exclusively celestial objects.
changed_reading.after: They form an enactable liturgy: truthful remembrance disciplines the mouth while directed and circular movement disciplines the body.

context_deltas.mechanism: A single confession causes expulsion from homes; migration on God's way then ends, even through death, in an entrance the displaced approve. The focus's good word is thus costly public allegiance, and the Praiseworthy's path is a reparative relocation that restores belonging.

activation_trace.role: Forced passage outside a place supplies the loss of home caused by the confession.
The voiced declaration 'our Lord is God' makes speech the explicit cause of displacement.
Movement from one dwelling to another carries the expelled confession into a migration.
An extended traversable way gives that migration its Godward course.
The paired verb and place of entry reverse expulsion into secure re-admission.
Satisfaction rather than resentment marks the affective completion of resettlement.
A soul made willing and pleased links good speech to the later satisfying entrance.
The straight road becomes the displacement-to-rehousing trajectory.
The praiseworthy final reach gives forced migration a repaired endpoint.

structural_cues: 22:40 says the displaced were expelled only for saying 'our Lord is God'; 22:58-59 follows migration, death, provision, and an entrance they find satisfying.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the costly utterance and the later migration-to-entry arc; I infer that the focus joins them as speech whose path repairs dispossession. A live alternative is that 22:40 and 22:58-59 describe separate collectives and should not be narratively fused.

changed_reading.before: Good speech is pleasant language received after safety has already been secured.
changed_reading.after: The good word can be a dangerous confession that costs a home, while the Praiseworthy's path carries its speakers into restorative belonging.

context_deltas.mechanism: Travel through ruined terrain is made causally productive of reasoning hearts and compliant hearing. A path is therefore an organ of discernment: moving through material signs teaches how to receive speech, so wholesome saying and straight travel form a feedback loop.

activation_trace.role: Going and flowing through the land supplies the embodied inquiry that changes perception.
Reason that restrains ignorance names the heart's gain from travel.
Hearing as understanding and compliance converts encountered speech into responsive knowledge.
The repeated blindness root, explicitly relocated from eyes to hearts, supplies the failure that pedagogical travel remedies.
Voiced speech becomes something the trained ear and heart must genuinely receive.
The straight road becomes a method for producing discernment, not merely a line to a destination.

structural_cues: 22:45 presents collapsed settlements, abandoned wells, and raised palaces; 22:46 immediately asks whether travel through the land might produce reasoning hearts and hearing ears.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ruin-to-travel-to-discernment sequence; I infer that the focus path can pedagogically condition reception of the focus speech. A live alternative is that 22:46 is an admonitory journey with no direct bearing on the eschatological sirat.

changed_reading.before: Speech gives information and a path merely carries an already informed traveler.
changed_reading.after: Walking among signs trains the heart to hear, so path and wholesome speech recursively make one another effective.

context_deltas.mechanism: Prophetic recitation is exposed to an alien casting, then the intrusion is removed and the signs made firm; knowledgeable hearers recognize truth, believe, humble their hearts, and are guided to a straight path. Al-tayyib min al-qawl can thus name speech after discrimination and repair, whose authenticated remainder generates guidance.

activation_trace.role: Recitation read and placed in its positions supplies the verbal medium into which interference enters.
Casting something down supplies the intrusive addition that makes verbal purification necessary.
Removal followed by replacement supplies the subtractive repair stage.
Firmness, precision, and secure construction supply the positive stabilization after removal.
Stable correspondence to reality names what knowledgeable recipients recognize in the repaired signs.
A low, quiet, spacious ground supplies the heart's receptive settling after recognition.
Gentle direction makes repaired and accepted discourse issue in guidance.
The explicit straight road reproduces the focus destination at the end of the processing chain.
Cleansing away contaminant supplies a cross-domain model for the speech made sound after removal.
Articulated discourse is the focus object re-read as the output of filtering and firming.

structural_cues: 22:52 orders recitation, satanic casting, removal, and firming; 22:53-54 then separates diseased or hard hearts from knowledgeable hearers whose hearts settle and who are guided to a straight path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a verbal contamination-removal-firming-recognition chain; I map that chain onto min al-qawl as a selected or purified verbal remainder. A live alternative is that al-tayyib denotes praise or greeting without encoding any textual filtering process.

changed_reading.before: Wholesome speech is a ready-made, uncontested object to which recipients are pointed.
changed_reading.after: Wholesome speech can be the discerned remainder of contested discourse after intrusion is removed and meaning is secured; that repaired speech then opens the straight path.

context_deltas.mechanism: Subtle beneficence greens the earth, the self-sufficient One is explicitly al-Hamid, and traversability is maintained by a running ship and a sky held back from collapse. The path of al-Hamid becomes an experienced support-system whose praiseworthiness is discovered in safe passage rather than supplied by travelers' praise.

activation_trace.role: Gentleness and beneficence name the subtle care by which dead-looking terrain becomes traversably alive.
Self-sufficiency prevents divine praiseworthiness from depending on the traveler's acclaim.
Being found praiseworthy after experience turns al-Hamid from an abstract title into a tested verdict.
The vessel moving in water supplies a concrete traveler carried through an otherwise unstable medium.
Flowing movement makes beneficent order dynamically traversable.
Holding and restraining the sky supplies the hidden maintenance that prevents passage from collapsing.
Tender compassion identifies the motive as care for people rather than mechanical control.
Gentle direction resonates with the later subtle beneficence that makes the route usable.
The focus road becomes the experienced line through a maintained world.
The one found praiseworthy after trial makes praise the traveler's discovery along the road.

structural_cues: 22:63-65 moves from rain and green earth to al-Ghani al-Hamid, then to a ship running at command, a restrained sky, and compassion toward people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies environmental renewal, the paired divine epithets, and protected movement; I infer that these are encountered evidence defining the path's praiseworthy owner. A live alternative is that the cosmic signs ground praise without specifying the focus sirat.

changed_reading.before: Al-Hamid is only a fixed honorific attached to the road.
changed_reading.after: Travel itself discloses why the self-sufficient owner of the road is praiseworthy: subtle care keeps earth fertile, vessels moving, and the sky from falling.

context_deltas.mechanism: Distinct communal rites need not become verbal combat. The sequence forbids contention, preserves invitation, answers argument with a bounded statement of epistemic humility, and defers final judgment to God. Good speech is therefore a conflict-governing procedure that keeps people on straight guidance without pretending to erase difference.

activation_trace.role: Worship and approach to God ground the distinct rites over which communities might contend.
Mutual pulling between two sides supplies the conflict that speech must contain.
Calling and inclining by speech preserves invitation as the constructive alternative to contest.
Direction and manner make straight guidance a posture maintained during disagreement.
Twisted, entangling contention names the verbal escalation answered by a concise saying.
Speech used to negotiate an affair supplies a procedural reading of the commanded reply.
Judgment between people relocates final adjudication away from the disputants.
Each party taking a different way preserves real difference rather than dissolving it rhetorically.
The focus good speech becomes a disciplined way of negotiating contested affairs.
The straight road is maintained by bounded speech despite divergent communal ways.

structural_cues: 22:67-69 moves from distinct rites to 'do not let them dispute with you,' then to invitation, a prescribed reply if they argue, and God's later judgment over differences.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the conflict-management sequence; I infer that it instantiates al-tayyib min al-qawl as procedural restraint. A live alternative is that the reply is a messenger-specific tactic rather than a general property of wholesome speech.

changed_reading.before: Good speech wins disagreement by stating the correct proposition more forcefully.
changed_reading.after: Good speech limits escalation, invites without coercion, acknowledges epistemic bounds, and leaves final judgment to God while straight guidance continues.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing commission joins selection, absence of constriction, Abraham's inherited milla, a conferred public name, reciprocal witnessing, and protective holding fast. The path of al-Hamid becomes a historically worn and publicly accountable vocation, not only a future road.

activation_trace.role: Selection and drawing near identify the community entrusted with the route.
Constriction supplies the explicitly negated condition, keeping the inherited way traversable.
A road made recognizable by repeated use turns inherited creed into a well-marked communal way.
Naming as public designation gives travelers a declared identity tied to the way.
Testimony grounded in knowledge turns the path into reciprocal public accountability.
Holding that prevents and preserves supplies the practice by which the community remains on the inherited way.
Direction, manner, and intent let the focus guidance extend into a historical communal vocation.
The straight road receives the closing image of a way worn clear by inherited practice.

structural_cues: 22:78 closes the surah with divine selection, no constriction in religion, Abraham's milla, the naming of Muslims, mutual witness, prayer, alms, and holding fast to God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inherited creed, public naming, witness, and preservation; I infer that these temporal and social practices instantiate the focus sirat. A live alternative is that the ending lists obligations downstream from guidance without redefining the focus road.

changed_reading.before: The Praiseworthy's path is an individual and exclusively eschatological route.
changed_reading.after: It is also an inherited, well-marked, non-constricting public vocation sustained by named identity, witness, repeated practice, and protective attachment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because hudu is a passive verb of guidance, not the noun for a sanctuary offering. It remains worth carrying because the focus inventory itself preserves gift and sacrificial-offering branches, while the surah's pilgrimage sequence names intentional approach, offered bodies, what reaches God, and guidance. Render only as a ritual echo in which the guided are ceremonially ushered or presented, never as the lexical translation of hudu.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The doubled h-d-y form can activate both a gift sent toward one loved and an offering conducted toward the sanctuary.

activation_trace.role: A gently dispatched gift to one loved supplies the image of recipients being welcomed and presented.
An offering conveyed toward the sanctuary supplies the ritual directionality behind the presentation.
Intentional approach to the revered gives the offering echo a destination.
The explicitly offered sacrificial body supplies the sequence's material presentation.
Causing something to reach another distinguishes material that does not reach God from piety that does.
The sanctuary-offering branch makes guidance at the rite's close resonate with directed presentation.

changed_reading.before: The recipients are simply shown where to go.
changed_reading.after: At an exploratory ritual register, they are ceremonially ushered as welcomed offerings, with wholesome speech functioning as a nonmaterial presentation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation is form-distant because it uses the packet's non-dominant h-d-d mapping for focus h-d-y. It remains anchored through that supplied focus branch and through 22:40's explicit demolition threat against worship places following a protected confession. Render as an acoustic and branch-level anti-demolition resonance, not as a claim that hudu means rebuilding or demolition.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The non-dominant focus mapping activates severe breaking and demolition beside the verse's good saying and Praiseworthy path.

activation_trace.role: Severe breaking and demolition supply the form-distant danger against which the doubled guidance can resonate.
Voiced speech keeps the resonance anchored in the focus's verbal destination.
The spoken confession supplies the vulnerable word whose public habitats require protection.
Pushing away harm supplies the social counterforce that prevents destruction.
A building brought down makes the demolition resonance explicit in the surah.
Divine remembrance running on tongues identifies what protected worship spaces allow to continue.

changed_reading.before: The focus concerns only private refinement after salvation.
changed_reading.after: As a contained root-split resonance, its good speech and praising way also answer the threatened demolition of the communal spaces where confession and remembrance can live.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because sirat ordinarily denotes a road, while the cited branch images swallowing and disappearance in passage. It remains valid as a cross-domain activation because the branch is supplied for the focus root and the ritual context places voiced remembrance beside eating and feeding. Render as an embodiment metaphor in which speech is taken in and shared, never as the lexical gloss of sirat.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The swallowing branch of s-r-t sits beside inward qawl and the wholesome quality of what is received.

activation_trace.role: Swallowing and disappearance through passage turn the road into an exploratory image of internalization.
Speech held inward before voicing supplies the verbal content that can be taken into the self.
Wholesome and lawful quality makes the internalized verbal material fit for incorporation.
Remembrance running on the tongue places voiced sacred speech beside consumption.
Taking in food supplies the material analogue for inward appropriation.
Feeding another turns internalized good into something redistributed rather than privately retained.

changed_reading.before: Wholesome speech is uttered alongside an independently traveled road.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, wholesome speech is taken in until it becomes a traversed disposition, then externalized and shared like nourishment.

strongest_changes: The punitive h-d-y plus ila construction in 22:4 makes the focus a moral rerouting rather than a redundant description of intrinsically good guidance.
The pilgrimage sequence fuses truthful remembrance, rejection of false speech, and directed bodily movement into an enacted speech-path mechanism.
The expulsion-migration-entry arc makes the good word a costly confession and the path a reparative resettlement.
The recitation-casting-removal-firming chain makes wholesome speech a discerned and repaired verbal remainder that can generate straight guidance.
The dispute sequence makes good speech a non-escalatory procedure that preserves invitation and defers final judgment without erasing difference.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context made the focus a hinge joining verbal purification to movement across distinct domains: post-entry cultivation, pilgrimage, displacement, historical learning, revelation repair, cosmic support, conflict practice, and inherited public vocation.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether min al-qawl supports a genuinely partitive filtered remainder or simply classifies the speech as wholesome.
How strongly the narrative order of entry, adornment, and guidance licenses a post-entry pedagogical sequence.
Whether al-Hamid primarily names the route's divine owner, its goal, or the praiseworthy quality encountered along it.
The offering, non-dominant h-d-d, and swallowing activations should remain analogical branch echoes rather than lexical claims.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Speech and road as parallel destinations.** Repeated `ه د ي B001/B002` supplies guidance toward a course; `ط ي ب B001/B003` is purity and cleansing; `ق و ل B001` uttered speech; `ص ر ط B001` the straight road; `ح م د B003` the one of many praiseworthy traits. The duplicated passive aligns good speech with the praised one's path. I infer that purified utterance is itself directional conduct. Guidance therefore reaches both what the inhabitants say and the route their lives take.
2. **Good speech as removal of mixture.** `ط ي ب B003` gives cleansing away filth, set after scenes where inner and outer states are exposed. I infer that garden speech is free of the contentious interlacing of 22:3 and 22:19. *Al-ṭayyib min al-qawl* thus reads as speech purified of adversarial contamination, not only pleasant wording.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 22:68 later enacted the purified speech mechanism by refusing extended contention and replacing it with one bounded statement of accountability.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Speech and route become one orientation system.** Repeated fixed `هُدُوا` activates `ه د ي:B001` (guidance toward a way), `ٱلطَّيِّب` activates `ط ي ب:B001` (good and pure) and `B003` (cleansing away filth), `ٱلْقَوْل` activates `ق و ل:B001` (uttered speech), and `صِرَاط` activates `ص ر ط:B001` (straight road). `22:25` immediately opposes this by blocking God's way, while `22:26` commands purification of the House. The packet supplies clean utterance, road, blockage, and cleansing; I infer that speech can orient movement as a road does. The ayah reads verbal purity as navigational conduct, not merely pleasant diction.
2. **Praise is the road's destination and quality.** Fixed `ٱلْحَمِيد` activates `ح م د:B003` (the praiseworthy one of many good traits). Because both clauses share passive guidance, good speech and the praiseworthy path converge on one endpoint. I infer that what makes the route straight is not geometry alone but its relation to a praiseworthy source. The second clause completes rather than merely repeats the first.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later `22:25-26` made the speech/road linkage concrete: one group blocks a shared worship-route, while the House is purified for coordinated movement. “Good speech” consequently has public spatial effects.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, yanılgının karşıtı olan doğru yönelişi, yolu veya doğruyu incelikle gösterip tanıtmayı, gösterileni benimsemeyi ve ilahi başarı desteğini birlikte kapsar. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği doğru biçimde yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, sıradan bir armağanı ya da yalnızca yolun kendisini değil, doğru yönü bildirme ve ona yönelme ilişkisini anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak dal anlamı tanımlanır; başka dallardaki armağan, adanmış sunu ve özel kullanım anlamları buraya taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kimseye yolu, doğruyu ya da benimsenmesi gereken yönü incelikle göstermek ve tanıtmak; gösterilen yönü kabul ederek doğruya ulaşmak, ayrıca bunun ilahi başarı desteğiyle gerçekleşmesidir.

facets.statement: Doğru yönü, yolu veya gerçeği incelikle göstermek, açıklamak ve tanıtmaktır.
Gösterilen doğru yönü isteyerek kabul etme ve ona ulaşma sürecini de kapsar.
Dinsel doğruya yöneltme ve bu yönelişi mümkün kılan ilahi başarı desteği özel bir gerçekleşmedir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar doğru yönü gösterme, yolu tanıtma ve yanılgının karşıtı olan doğruya erişme çekirdeğinde birleşir; anlatım, insanın gösterileni seçip benimsemesini ve ilahi başarı desteğini de içerir. Bir kaynakta itaat ve sakınma da bu anlam alanındaki gerçekleşmeler arasında sayılır.

concept_gloss.text: doğru yolu gösterme ve doğruya yönelme
concept_gloss.applicability: Yolun veya gerçeğin bildirilmesiyle başlayıp gösterilen doğru yönün benimsenmesine uzanan bütün çekirdek için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Gösterme, tanıtma, benimseme ve doğruya ulaşma basamaklarını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişiye somut ya da düşünsel bir yolun tanıtıldığı geçişlerde doğal bir karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Yolu bildirme ve kişiyi doğru yöne sevk etme yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Gösterileni benimseme ve ilahi başarı desteği yönlerini tek başına anlatmaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Gösterilen yönü kabul edip doğruya ulaşan kişinin durumunu anlatan bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Doğru yönü benimseyerek ona ulaşma sonucunu açıkça korur.
error_profile.loses: Başkasının yolu gösterme eylemini ve ilahi başarı desteğini belirtmez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü bir işin yönünü ve amacını, kişinin gidişini, görünür tutumunu ve yöntemini, ayrıca sürmekte olan söz veya işi bırakmamayı birlikte verir. Verilen çerçeve bu çok parçalı fakat bağlantılı kullanımı korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca genel bir yaşam tarzı değildir; yön ve amaç bildiren kullanımlarla belirli bir işte veya söylemde kalma kullanımını da içerir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yön, gidiş ve tutum bildiren biçimler ile kalıplaşmış benzerlik ve yineleme kullanımları ayrı yüzler olarak tutulur; özel kullanımlar çıplak kökün tümüne yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir işin yönü, amacı ve izlenen doğrultusu ile bir kimsenin gidişi, görünür tutumu ve yöntemidir. Belirli anlatımlarda yürütülen söz ya da işten sapmama, başkasının yolunu izleme, ona benzeme veya aynı karşılığı yineleme anlamı kazanır.

facets.statement: Bir işin yönünü, hedefini ve izlenen doğrultusunu bildirir.
Bir kimsenin gidişini, görünür tutumunu ve izlediği yöntemi anlatır.
Sürmekte olan söz veya işi bırakmama ve başkasının izlediği yolu izleme kullanımını içerir.
Özel bir söyleyişte benzerini verme veya aynı işi yeniden yapma anlamı taşır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynak anlatımı yön ve amaç ile kişinin izlediği yol ve görünür tutumu aynı kavramsal alanda toplar; sürmekte olan işten sapmama, başkasının yolunu izleme ve özel bir söyleyişte benzerini ya da tekrarını yapma kullanımları buna bağlıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir işin doğrultusunu ve bir kişinin davranış biçimini birlikte karşılayan genel kavram haritasında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yön, amaç, yöntem, görünür tutum ve izlenen gidiş çekirdeğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir işin hangi doğrultuya baktığı veya hangi amaçla yürütüldüğü sorulduğunda uygundur.

error_profile.loses: Kişinin tutumunu, yöntemini ve özel benzerlik ya da yineleme kullanımlarını dışarıda bırakır.

error_profile.loses: Bir işin soyut yönünü ve benzerini verme ya da yineleme kullanımını belirtmez.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه هدي الأمر أو هديته بمعنى جهته ووجهته وقصده وسيرته وطريقته وسمته وما يلازم ذلك من لزوم الحديث أو العمل والمماثلة في هدياها

branches.source_phrase_ar: خذ في هديتك أي فيما كنت فيه من الحديث أو العمل ولا تعدل عنه؛ هدية أمره وسيرته؛ هدى هدي فلان أي سار سيرته (sihah)؛ هدية أمره أي جهة أمره؛ هديت به أي قصدت به؛ هديه أي سمته؛ ليس لهذا الأمر هدية ولا قبلة ولا دبرة ولا وجهة؛ هدياها أي مثلها أو أعاودك (tahdhib)؛ هدية فلان وهديه أي طريقته (mufradat)؛ نظر فلان هدي أمره أي جهته؛ ما أحسن هديته أي هديه؛ رميت بآخر هدياه أي قصده (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü temel olarak bir şeyin ilk veya önde bulunan bölümünü bildirir; yol gösterme, bazı öndekilerin başkalarına öncülük etmesinden doğan bağlı bir açıklamadır. Bu nedenle dal korunabilir, ancak her öndeki parçanın yol gösterdiği düşünülmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek öncülük etmek değil, önde veya ilk sırada bulunmaktır; yol gösterme yalnızca uygun örneklerde buna bağlanır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel olarak ilk veya öndeki şey anlamı ile atların, yaban hayvanlarının, okun ve koyunun belirli ön parçalarını adlandıran kullanımlar ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin ilk, önde bulunan veya öne çıkan bölümü ya da üyesidir. Atların boyunları veya ilk sırası, yaban hayvanlarının öncüleri, okun ucu, koyunun boynu ve sahibinin önünde ilerleyen değnek bu konumsal çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir bütünün ilk veya önde bulunan bölümü ya da üyesidir.
Atların boyunlarını veya ilk sırasını ve yaban hayvanlarının önde gidenlerini adlandırır.
Okun ucunu ve koyunun boynunu, öndeki parçalar olmaları bakımından adlandırır.
Önden ilerleyen değnek veya kılavuz, önde bulunma yoluyla başkasına yön gösterir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bir şeyin ilk ve öndeki bölümünde birleşir; atların boynu ya da ilk sırası, yaban hayvanlarının öncüleri, koyun boynu, ok ucu ve önde ilerleyen değnek bu konumsal çekirdeği farklı nesnelerde gerçekleştirir. Önden giden kılavuz da aynı konumsal ilişkiyle adlandırılır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الهادي أو الهادية بمعنى أول الشيء وما تقدم منه كأعناق الخيل وأول رعيلها وأوائل الوحش ورقبة الشاة ونصل السهم والعصا أو الدليل حين يتقدمان
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الهدى المجرد عن معنى التقدم ولا الهدية العطية ولا الهادي الراكس في البيدر
branches.source_phrase_ar: الهادي من كل شيء أوله؛ هوادي الخيل أعناقها أو أول رعيل؛ العصا هاديا لأنها تتقدمه؛ الدليل يسمى هاديا لتقدمه (ayn)؛ هادي السهم نصله؛ الهادي العنق؛ هوادي الخيل أعناقها أو أول رعيل؛ الهاديات أوائل الوحش (sihah)؛ الهادية من كل شيء أوله وما تقدم منه؛ هادية الشاة الرقبة؛ هوادي الخيل أعناقها أو أول رعيل؛ هاديات الوحش أوائلها (tahdhib)؛ هوادي الوحش متقدماتها الهادية لغيرها (mufradat)؛ كل متقدم لذلك هاد؛ هوادي الخيل أعناقها؛ هاديها أول رعيل؛ الهادية العصا لأنها تتقدم ممسكها (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü sevgi bağı bulunan birine incelik ve iyilik amacıyla gönderilen armağanı, karşılıklı armağan vermeyi, armağanın sunulduğu tabağı ve sık armağan veren kişiyi açıkça kapsar. Dal çerçevesi bütün bu türevleri doğru sınırlar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Sıradan mal aktarımı değil, incelik ve yakınlık işareti olan armağan esastır; kutsal yere adanan sunu ayrı daldadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak armağan ve armağan verme alanı tanımlanır; kutsal amaçlı sunu, gelini eşine götürme ve şiirsel atışma anlamları içeri alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Sevgi veya yakınlık duyulan birine incelik ve iyilik göstergesi olarak bir şey gönderme ya da verme ve verilen şeydir. Karşılıklı armağanlaşma, sunma tabağı ve bunu sık yapan kişi bu çekirdeğe bağlı kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Sevgi veya yakınlık duyulan birine incelik göstergesi olarak verilen şeydir.
Böyle bir armağanı birine göndermek veya vermek eylemidir.
İnsanların birbirlerine karşılıklı armağan vermesini kapsar.
Armağanın üzerine konduğu tabağı ve sık armağan veren kişiyi adlandırır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar armağanı yakınlık duyulan kişiye incelik ve iyilik amacıyla verilen şey olarak tanımlar; verme eylemi, karşılıklı verme, sunma tabağı ve sık veren kişi bu ortak çekirdeğin bağlı türevleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Armağanın kendisini, verilmesini ve yakınlık kuran karşılıklı değişimi birlikte temsil eden genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Armağanı, incelik amacını, verme eylemini ve karşılıklılığı birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yakınlık ve incelik göstergesi olarak verilen nesnenin adlandırıldığı bağlamlarda en doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: İncelik amacıyla verilen şey olma çekirdeğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Verme eylemini, karşılıklılığı, sunma tabağını ve sık veren kişi anlamını kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsanların birbirlerine karşılıklı olarak armağan verdiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Karşılıklı armağan verme ilişkisini ve yakınlık yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Tek armağanın adını, sunma tabağını ve sık veren kişi anlamını belirtmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Karşılıklı verme, armağan tabağı ve sık armağan veren kişi bu dalın türev alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Seçkin veya ender bulunan bir nesne ve birine iyilikte bulunma vurgusu komşu dalda öne çıkar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da birine yakınlık ve iyilik göstergesi olarak sunulan armağanı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal armağan verme olayını ve ona bağlı karşılıklılık ile araç ve kişi adlarını geliştirir; komşu dal sunulan seçkin nesne veya iyilik yönünde daha dardır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün armağan, bağış ve iyilik adayları değerlendirildi; incelik amaçlı armağana en yakın sınırı veren aday seçildi.
branches.branch_image_ar: بعثة لطف وهدية إلى ذي مودة
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الهدية والهدايا والإهداء بمعنى العطية اللطيفة إلى ذي مودة والتهادي بين الناس والمهدى الطبق والمهداء كثير الإهداء
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الهدي المهدى إلى الحرم ولا العروس المهدية إلى زوجها ولا المهاداة الشعرية إذا أريدت مهاجاة متبادلة
branches.source_phrase_ar: الهدية ما أهديت إلى ذي مودة من بر (ayn)؛ الهدية واحدة الهدايا؛ أهديت له وإليه؛ المهدى ما يهدى فيه؛ التهادي أن يهدي بعضهم إلى بعض؛ المهداء الذي من عادته أن يهدي (sihah)؛ أهديت الهدية إهداء؛ امرأة مهداء؛ المهدى الطبق الذي يهدى عليه (tahdhib)؛ الهدية مختصة باللطف؛ المهدى الطبق؛ المهداء من يكثر إهداء الهدية (mufradat)؛ الهدية ما أهديت من لطف إلى ذي مودة؛ المهدي الطبق تهدى عليه (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü kutsal eve veya bölgeye yakınlaşma amacıyla gönderilen hayvanı, malı ya da eşyayı bildirir; bazı anlatımlar alanı özellikle büyükbaş hayvanlarla sınırlar, bazıları daha geniş tutar. Dal çerçevesi bu kapsam değişkenliğini ve deveye uzanan kullanımı korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal insanlar arasındaki sıradan armağanı değil, kutsal bir hedefe yaklaşma amacıyla ayrılıp gönderilen sunuyu anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak adanmış sunu anlamı tanımlanır; sıradan armağan, ibadete giriş ve kutsal yolculuğun kendisi bu dala katılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Kutsal eve veya bölgeye yakınlık kazanma amacıyla ayrılıp gönderilen hayvan, mal ya da eşyadır. Kimi anlatımlar bunu özellikle büyükbaş hayvanlara bağlar; develerin genel olarak aynı adla anılması ise bu kullanımdan genişlemedir.

facets.statement: Kutsal bir hedefe yakınlık amacıyla ayrılıp gönderilen sunudur.
Sununun kapsamı kimi anlatımlarda büyükbaş hayvanlarla sınırlı, kimilerinde mal ve eşyayı da içerecek kadar geniştir.
Develerin genel olarak bu adla anılması, kutsal yere gönderilen deve sunusundan gelişen bir genişlemedir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kutsal hedefe yakınlık amacıyla gönderilen sunuda birleşir; kapsamın yalnızca büyükbaş hayvanlar mı yoksa mal ve eşya da mı olduğu değişir, develerin genel adı olarak kullanım da bu çekirdekten genişler.

concept_gloss.text: kutsal yere adanan hayvan, mal veya eşya
concept_gloss.applicability: Yakınlık amacıyla kutsal hedefe gönderilen sununun kaynaklardaki dar ve geniş kapsamlarını birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Kutsal hedefi, adama amacını ve hayvandan mal ile eşyaya değişen kapsamı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kutsal bölgeye gönderilen sununun özellikle büyükbaş bir hayvan olduğu bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kutsal hedefe yakınlık amacıyla ayrılan hayvan yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Mal ve eşyanın da sunu olabildiği geniş kaynak kapsamını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Adın kutsal sunu bağından genişleyerek genel deve topluluğunu anlattığı kullanımda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Develere uzanan adlandırma genişlemesini doğrudan korur.
error_profile.loses: Kutsal hedef, adama amacı ve başka tür sunular bu kısa karşılıkta görünmez.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: kutsal bölgeye adanan hayvan, mal veya eşya
adanmış sunu adından genişleyen deve adı

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kutsal hedefe gönderilen belirli hayvan, mal veya eşya ve bundan gelişen deve adı bu dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yakınlık amacıyla yapılan her türlü eylem ve kullanılan her türlü araç komşu dalın daha geniş alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da kutsal yakınlık elde etmek amacıyla sunulan veya yapılan şeyi kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal gönderilen somut sunuyu ve hedefini sınırlar; komşu dal ise aynı amaçla yapılan eylemleri ve kullanılan araçları genel olarak kapsar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: İbadet, ziyaret, kesim, sunu ve hazırlık adaylarının tümü değerlendirildi; en açıklayıcı genel amaç ile somut sunu ayrımı yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الهدي أو الهدي المشدد والمخفف بمعنى ما يهدى إلى مكة أو الحرم أو بيت الله من النعم أو المال أو المتاع قربة وما توسع منه إلى البدنة والإبل
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الهدية العادية بين الناس ولا مجرد الدلالة والإرشاد
branches.source_phrase_ar: الهدي والهدي ما أهديت إلى مكة؛ كل شيء تهديه من مال أو متاع فهو هدي (ayn)؛ الهدي ما يهدى إلى الحرم من النعم؛ مالى هدي؛ حتى يبلغ الهدى محله (sihah)؛ أهديت الهدي إلى بيت الله؛ الهدي خفيف وعليه هدية أي بدنة؛ ما يهدى إلى مكة من النعم وغيره من مال أو متاع؛ العرب تسمي الإبل هديا (tahdhib)؛ الهدي مختص بما يهدى إلى البيت؛ فما استيسر من الهدي؛ هديا بالغ الكعبة (mufradat)؛ الهدي والهدي ما أهدي من النعم إلى الحرم قربة إلى الله تعالى (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü gelini eşinin yanına götürme, bir araya getirip katma eylemini, bu eylemin adını ve götürülen gelinin adlandırılmasını birlikte verir. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu olay ve katılımcı ayrımını doğru korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal evliliğin tamamını veya eş olma durumunu değil, gelinin eşinin yanına götürülmesi aşamasını anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Gelini eşine götürme ve götürülen gelin anlamları tanımlanır; armağan verme ya da düğünün bütün aşamaları bu dala taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir gelini eşinin yanına götürmek, onunla bir araya getirip ona katmak ve bu götürülme olayıdır. Aynı alan, eşine götürülen gelinin kendisini de adlandırır.

facets.statement: Gelini eşinin yanına götürme ve onunla bir araya getirme eylemidir.
Gelinin eşine götürülmesi olayının adı olarak kullanılır.
Eşinin yanına götürülen gelinin kendisini adlandırır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar gelini eşine götürme ve onunla birleştirme eyleminde birleşir; eylem adı ile götürülen gelini belirten edilgen adlandırma aynı olay yapısına bağlanır. Gelin adının eşine götürülmeden veya kocasının yanında tutsak benzeri sayılmasından doğduğu yönünde iki açıklama aktarılır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Götürme eylemini, olayın adını ve götürülen gelin katılımcısını aynı çekirdek altında temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Gelini eşine götürme, birleştirme ve götürülen gelin katılımcısını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Eylemin kendisinin anlatıldığı etkin cümlelerde doğal Türkçe karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Gelinin eşinin yanına götürülmesi eylemini açıkça korur.
error_profile.loses: Olay adını ve götürülen gelinin adlandırılmasını tek başına karşılamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Eylemden etkilenen gelinin adlandırıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Götürülen gelin katılımcısını ve varış ilişkisini korur.
error_profile.loses: Götürme eylemini ve olayın adını doğrudan ifade etmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Eşine götürülen gelinin edilgen adla anılması ve birleştirme ilişkisi bu dalda belirgindir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Düğün alayı, gelini taşıma ve gelinin taşındığı kapalı taşıt komşu dalın alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da gelinin eşinin yanına götürülmesi aşamasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal götürme eylemi ile gelin katılımcısını adlandırır; komşu dal aynı olayın tören, taşıma ve taşıt yönlerini daha ayrıntılı kapsar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Eş, evlilik, düğün, gelin taşıma ve evliliksizlik adayları değerlendirildi; aynı olay aşamasını paylaşan en yakın komşu seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه هديت المرأة أو العروس إلى زوجها وهداؤها وكونها مهدية أو هدي في معنى مفعول
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الهدية العادية ولا الهدي إلى الحرم إلا من جهة أصل الإرسال
branches.source_phrase_ar: الهداء مصدر قولك هديت المرأة إلى زوجها؛ وهي مهدية وهدي (sihah)؛ هديت العروس فأنا أهديها هداء؛ أهدى الرجل امرأته جمعها إليه وضمها؛ المرأة سميت هديا لأنها كالأسيرة عند زوجها أو لأنها تهدى إلى زوجها (tahdhib)؛ الهدي يقال في العروس؛ هديت العروس إلى زوجها (mufradat)؛ الهدى العروس وقد هديت إلى بعلها هداء (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü öncelikle bir topluluktan sığınma veya güvence isteyen ve kutsal sunuya benzer dokunulmazlığı bulunan erkeği anlatır; bazı açıklamalar aynı biçimi tutsak için de verir. Dal korunabilir, ancak sığınmacı ile tutsak tek bir durum gibi birleştirilmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dokunulmaz sığınmacı çekirdektir; tutsak anlamı ortak bir tanım değil, açıkça ayrılması gereken kaynak varyantıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak kişi adı, dokunulmaz sığınmacı çekirdeği ve tutsak varyantıyla tanımlanır; kutsal sunu veya gelin anlamı buraya alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir topluluktan sığınma veya güvence isteyen ve bu yüzden dokunulmaz sayılan erkektir. Bazı kaynak açıklamalarında aynı ad tutsak erkek için de kullanılır.

facets.statement: Bir topluluğa sığınan veya onlardan güvence alan, dokunulmazlığı bulunan erkektir.
Bazı kaynak açıklamalarında aynı ad tutsak erkek için kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak anlatımı, güvence isteyen ve kutsal sunuya benzer dokunulmazlığı bulunan erkeği öne çıkarır; tutsak anlamı ise aynı ad için aktarılan ayrı bir açıklama olarak korunur.

concept_gloss.applicability: Ana kişi türünü ve onunla birleştirilmemesi gereken tutsak varyantını birlikte görünür kılar.

error_profile.preserves: Sığınma, güvence ve dokunulmazlık çekirdeğiyle tutsak varyantını ayrı tutar.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir topluluğa sığınıp onlardan güvence isteyen kişinin anlatıldığı ana kullanımda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sığınan kişinin güvence istemesini ve dokunulmaz sayılmasını korur.
error_profile.loses: Aynı ad için aktarılan tutsak açıklamasını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnızca bazı kaynak açıklamalarının aynı kişi adını tutsak için kullandığı bağlamda geçerlidir.

error_profile.preserves: Ayrı kaynak varyantındaki tutsak kişi anlamını korur.
error_profile.loses: Dokunulmaz sığınmacı ve güvence ilişkisini bütünüyle dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal güvence isteyen dokunulmaz kişiyi adlandırır ve ayrıca tutsak varyantı taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal sığınma isteme, güvence verme, koruma ve zulümden kurtarma olayının bütününü anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir kişinin bir topluluktan güvence istemesi ve onların korumasına girmesi alanını paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal olayın dokunulmaz kişi katılımcısını adlandırır; komşu dal ise sığınma ve koruma ilişkisinin eylem ve durum yapısını kapsar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Dokunulmazlık, güvence, sığınma, korunma ve tutsaklık adayları değerlendirildi; kişi adı ile koruma olayı arasındaki en açıklayıcı ilişki seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الهدي للرجل ذي الحرمة المستجير أو الآخذ عهدا قبل أن يجار وللأسير في بعض الأقوال
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الهدي القرباني إلا من جهة التشبيه بحرمة هدي البيت ولا العروس إلا في تفسير محتمل عند تهذيب اللغة
branches.source_phrase_ar: الرجل الذي له حرمة كحرمة هدي البيت؛ يقال للأسير أيضا هدي (sihah)؛ الهدي الرجل ذو الحرمة وهو أن يأتي القوم يستجيرهم أو يأخذ منهم عهدا؛ يقال للأسير أيضا الهدي (tahdhib)؛ وقيل الهدي الأسير (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü sağa sola sallanarak yürümeyi ve güçsüz kişinin iki kişiye dayanarak yürümesini açıkça ayırır; kadınların ve ağır develerin yürüyüşü örnek olarak verilir. Dal çerçevesi hareket, dayanak ve neden ayrımlarını korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek sallantılı yürüyüştür; iki kişiye dayanma güçsüzlük koşuluna bağlı özel bir yapıdır ve armağan alışverişiyle ilişkili değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Sallanarak yürüme biçimi ile iki kişi arasında onlara dayanarak yürüme kalıbı ayrı yüzler olarak tanımlanır; dayanak koşulu bütün kullanımlara yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Yürürken sağa sola sallanmak veya yalpalamaktır. Güçsüz bir kişinin iki kişi arasında ilerleyip ikisine dayanması bunun özel yapısıdır; kadınların ve ağır develerin yürüyüşü örneklenir.

facets.statement: Yürüyüş sırasında sağa sola sallanma ve yalpalama hareketidir.
Güçsüz kişinin iki kişi arasında yürüyerek her ikisine dayanması özel yapıdır.
Kadınların ve ağır develerin sallantılı yürüyüşü bu hareketin örnekleri olarak verilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar sallantılı yürüyüş ile güçsüzlük yüzünden iki kişiye dayanarak ilerleme yapısında birleşir; kadın ve ağır deve yürüyüşleri çekirdeği açıklayan örneklerdir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Genel yalpalama hareketini ve güçsüzlüğe bağlı iki kişiden destek alma yapısını birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Sallanma, yürüme, güçsüzlük koşulu ve başkalarına dayanma öğelerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sağa sola sallanan yürüyüş biçiminin genel olarak anlatıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yürüyüşte sağa sola sallanma ve dengesiz ilerleme yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Güçsüzlük nedeniyle iki kişiye dayanma yapısını belirtmez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Güçsüz kişinin iki destekçi arasında ilerlediği özel söz diziminde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: İki kişiden destek almayı ve güçsüzlük koşulunu açıkça korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü bir erkeği bön ve güçsüz, ayrıca ağır ve uyuşuk olarak niteleyen kişi adlarını verir. Dal çerçevesi zihinsel yavaşlık, bedensel güçsüzlük ve ağırlık özelliklerini doğru biçimde toplar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal bir kişiye yönelik olumsuz nitelemedir; gelini eşine götürme olay adıyla veya sakin ve düzgün tutumla karıştırılmaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü sakinlik ile bozgun halinde kaçan kişinin telaşlı hızından uzak, düzgün ve güzel bir yürüyüş ya da tutumu birlikte verir. Dal çerçevesi sakinliği tek başına bırakmayıp görünüş ve davranış niteliğiyle bağlar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak sakin ve düzgün tutum anlamı tanımlanır; başka kökteki durulma eylemi veya genel yaşam tarzı anlamları eklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bu dal, bir varligin dayanak ve butunlugunu agir bicimde kirip yikma, cokertme veya bu duruma dusme anlamindadir. Felaketin kisiyi sarsip gucunu kirmasi bunun kisi uzerindeki ozel kullanimidir.

facets.statement: Bir varlığın sayı, miktar veya ölçü bakımından çok olmayışıdır.
Azlık, kişinin yoksullaşması veya toplum içinde düşük ve değersiz görülmesi sonucuna uzanabilir.
Bir şeyi gerçekte ya da değerlendiren kişinin gözünde az sayma ve az gösterme anlamını taşır.
Belirli olumsuzluk ve sıklık yapılarında hiç yokluğu veya bir eylemin pek seyrek gerçekleşmesini anlatır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyin en üstünü veya başını çekirdek anlam olarak verir; dağın yuvarlak üst bölümü, insan başı ve kılıcın başındaki topuz bu çekirdeğin açık uzmanlaşmalarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol uzamsal başı ve en üst parçayı bildirir; sayısal azlık ya da büyük kap anlamını içermez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel baş ve en üst bölüm anlamı ile dağ tepesi, insan başı ve kılıç topuzu gibi yapıya bağlı uzmanlaşmalar ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin başını veya en üst bölümünü bildirir. Dağın üstteki yuvarlak parçası, insan başı ve kılıcın sap ucundaki topuz bu uzamsal çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

Dağın en üstünde yer alan, kimi tanımda yuvarlak biçimli bölümünü adlandırır.
İnsan başı ile kılıcın sap ucundaki başlık veya topuz da aynı üst ve baş kavramıyla adlandırılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi büyük bir küp veya iri kap anlamında birleşir; iki kaplık ölçü ve belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler de aynı kap anlamını somutlaştırır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol büyük bir kap türünü ve onun ölçü değerini kapsar; nicelik azlığı veya dağ tepesi anlamını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Büyük küp anlamı çekirdektir; belirli bir bölgeye bağlanan kap adı ile iki kaplık ölçü yalnızca kendi yapılardaki uzmanlaşmalardır.

concept_map.definition: Büyük bir küpü veya küpe benzeyen iri kabı bildirir. Belirli bir bölgenin iri küpleri ve iki böyle kabın aldığı miktar bu kap anlamına bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Küpe benzeyen, özellikle sıvı taşımaya veya saklamaya elverişli büyük bir kaptır.
Belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler veya büyük toprak kaplar bu adın tanınmış bir türünü oluşturur.
İki büyük kap, bu iki kabın kendisini veya onların aldığı sıvı miktarını bildiren bir ölçü değeri kazanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar iri bir küp veya büyük kap üzerinde birleşir; tanınmış bölgesel kaplar büyüklüğü örnekler, iki kaplık kullanım ise nesne adını kapasite ölçüsüne taşır.
